_README: CLOSED HISTORY. `list_tool_autonomy` is CREATE OR REPLACEd with its whole body, so the newest
declaration by filename is the only one prod runs, and a migration written from a stale copy of
the catalogue erases every row added after that copy was taken. tool-catalogue-lint walks every
consecutive pair in the chain and fails on any row that disappears without a reason.
These removals predate that rule. They are listed by EXACT (migration, tool_key) pair and never
as a count, because a count stays flat while membership churns — one row quietly dropped and
another added nets to zero and passes. The same reasoning is written out at
tool-catalogue-lint.mjs:27-31.
SHRINK ONLY. Nothing is ever added here. A new deliberate removal is declared in the migration
that makes it, with `-- catalogue-removal-ok: <tool_key> — <why>`; the guard reads that line and
the reason is required. When a baselined removal stops happening the guard says so and this file
loses the entry.
shadowedRemovals  keys present in the preceding declaration and absent from this one.
phantomRows       rows in the live catalogue with no entry in _shared/action-risk.ts. No runtime
reads their stored mode, so the operator's switch governs nothing (§70.1).
crm_delete_contact is a tombstone whose row outlived the tool; pipeline_create
and pipeline_add_stage are named 'phantom/unclassified' in
src/solo/data/capabilityTools.ts:171; social_post is filtered out at both read
sites. The catalogue is meant to be exactly the governed set — these are the
four rows that are not, held at four.
